Details
  • Paper: Lotus: Diffusion-based Visual Foundation Model for High-quality Dense Prediction, ICLR 2025, 2024-09-26
  • Original code: https://github.com/EnVision-Research/Lotus at b737e12238d2
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/EnVision-Research/Lotus/blob/b737e12238d2a41fc582ee8c6c6b1104d318d799/LICENSE (Apache-2.0); https://huggingface.co/jingheya/lotus-normal-g-v1-1/blob/92b42fd7f5c3f97f09a2af8e96263d87ea899bf1/README.md (license: apache-2.0)
  • Training data: Stable Diffusion 2 base (LAION-5B subsets) fine-tuned on the synthetic Hypersim and Virtual KITTI 2 per the Lotus paper (arXiv 2409.18124)
  • Options: long_side = 768 (>= 0; also processing_res), seed = 42
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: lotus-normal-g-v1-1, lotus-normal-d-v1-1
  • Outputs: normals; kind: none
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): lotus-normal-g-v1-1 3000x4000 (3.0 GiB peak allocated, 3.7 reserved); lotus-normal-d-v1-1 3000x4000 (3.0 GiB peak allocated, 3.7 reserved)
  • lotus-normal-g-v1-1 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 63 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 183 s (ONNX + engine).
  • lotus-normal-d-v1-1 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 64 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 183 s (ONNX + engine).
  • lotus-normal-g-v1-1 original 994x1482: the authors' float16 model option; upstream Lotus-G pipeline, diffusers 0.41.0, timestep 999, seed 42
  • lotus-normal-d-v1-1 original 994x1482: the authors' float16 model option; upstream Lotus-D pipeline, diffusers 0.41.0, timestep 999, seed 42
  • lotus-normal-g-v1-1 load / first call: original 10.43 s / 1.15 s, portable 4.37 s / 0.588 s, kernels 3.49 s / 0.384 s
  • lotus-normal-d-v1-1 load / first call: original 2.1 s / 0.556 s, portable 5.48 s / 0.693 s, kernels 2.7 s / 0.317 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

AbsRel / delta1 after a least-squares scale + shift fit (in disparity space for inverse-depth models), mean over images. Normals: angle to the ground-truth normal over the pixels with ground truth (Marigold's evaluation sets), mean over images. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.00053 and p99 <= 0.0022 (absolute error of the output normals).

Limitations

  • Normals only: no depth.
  • Lotus-G: the seeded noise comes from a CPU generator and differs from a CUDA generator's for the same seed (Lotus-D uses it only for the image latent's posterior sample).
  • A traced or exported module reuses the noise of its traced shape.
